milestone.title: Agent health rollups — milestone summary, finding batch ops, jq-loop prevention

intent.outcome: Agents remediating or reviewing milestones get first-class mp commands for health rollups and finding batch writes — eliminating the ad-hoc mp show | jq and silent no-op update patterns that caused the M85 remediation loop (session ses_0df3).

problem.description: During M85 remediation (session ses_0df3, Jul 2026) an agent ran mp show milestone 85 | jq ~60 times to compute step/AC/finding counts and check verification evidence. It then looped on mp milestone update --json with a findings array — returning ok:true but persisting nothing — before hand-editing TOML with sed. M79 shipped --fields, validate --summary, and reviews sweep, but not per-milestone health rollups or finding batch resolve. Agents also did not know mp reviews finding * exists (mp --help | grep finding finds nothing). Postmortem: session-ses_0df3.md.

in_scope: mp show milestone <id> --summary: step/AC/finding counts, review_state, force_bypassed flag
mp reviews finding list <id>: summary block (open/fixed/total/other)
mp reviews finding resolve <id> --all: batch resolve open findings
mp milestone update --json: hard-error on unsupported fields with redirect hints
AGENTS.md + AGENT-READINESS + AGENT-PLAYBOOK: jq replacements, loop guard, remediation commands
Integration tests in agent_summary.rs and review_lifecycle.rs
out_of_scope: mp help keyword search / topics index

acceptance_criteria.description: mp show milestone <id> --summary returns JSON with steps, acceptance_criteria, findings counts, review_state, and verification.force_bypassed
mp reviews finding list <id> includes summary counts (full milestone, not just filtered list)
mp reviews finding resolve <id> --all resolves every open finding and returns resolved_count
mp milestone update --json with findings field exits non-zero redirecting to mp reviews finding commands
AGENTS.md and AGENT-READINESS document --summary, batch resolve, loop guard; say not to pipe mp to jq for health checks

design_decisions.choice: Use --summary flag on show milestone (not a new top-level command)
design_decisions.rationale: Matches M79 opt-in rollup pattern; agents already run show milestone during remediation.

design_decisions.choice: Finding status vocabulary stays open → fixed (not resolved)
design_decisions.rationale: review_state and lifecycle rollup key off fixed; M85 loop used wrong resolved status.

work_packages.name: Agent docs
work_packages.goal: Document jq replacements and loop guard

steps.action: Add milestone_health.rs and show milestone --summary flag
Add summary to reviews finding list and resolve --all batch command

Update AGENTS.md AGENT-READINESS AGENT-PLAYBOOK and master-plan AGENTS.md
steps.done_when: Docs list --summary, resolve --all, loop guard, no-jq guidance
